about: Every place the mod touches Risk of Rain 2 (RoR2.dll, 2026-10 build, decompiled with ilspycmd for reference only). method = 'event' subscribes to a public RoR2 event, 'harmony-prefix'/'harmony-postfix' patch with HarmonyX (shipped with BepInEx 5), 'component' = our own MonoBehaviour on our own objects. No R2API: content is registered through RoR2's own ContentManager provider API so nothing extra has to be installed or bundled. reads = which sheet columns drive it.

rows.purpose: register body prefabs, survivor defs, skill defs/families, entity state types and buff defs (one IContentPackProvider; loads the Deadlock cache during the loading screen)
answer DLR_* tokens (names, subtitles, lore, skill names/descriptions, buff names) in every language
apply our buffs' move speed / attack speed / armor / regen (vanilla level scaling of base stats is untouched and comes from the level* fields)
Fixation and Catalyst damage amp from their owner, Bullet Dance evasion; records damage taken for Infernal Resilience
add ult charge = damage dealt / attacker damage stat * 100 (in % units), except the ult's own damage
hold the charge meter, keep the ult skill's stock at 0 until charged, read the ult key (config, default F) for the local player and execute the ult skill
clone the Special skill icon once into a 5th icon bound to the ult GenericSkill, label it with the key and show the charge %

rows.target: DeadlockOfRain.DeadlockModel (built per hero from the cache)
rows.purpose: SkinnedMeshRenderer + skeleton + legacy Animation clips from the player's Deadlock install, attached to the body's ModelLocator with CharacterModel/HurtBoxGroup/ChildLocator
pick idle/run/sprint/jump/land clips from CharacterMotor + InputBank each frame, layer gestures (fire/reload/abilities) on the upper body, pitch the spine to the aim
play the hero's Deadlock sounds (decoded WAVs in the cache) at volume_master * volume_sfx, with distance falloff from the camera
Melty test.checks: when the test env var is set, start a run as each hero, fire every skill, charge and fire the ult, level up, and report each check
